review_candidates.title: AI Systems Architect
review_candidates.description: Overview An early-stage engineering team is building an AI-focused platform for large-scale data processing and model evaluation, and is looking for a senior engineer to help shape it from the foundation up. The work spans agentic systems, high-volume data pipelines, and automated evaluation — architecture meant to stay reliable and defensible at scale, not just perform in a demo. This is a role with wide ownership. You'll design core systems, build and operate the data layer end to end, and partner closely with the engineering lead on the hard technical calls. It's equal parts architecture and hands-on operations — you should be as comfortable designing a system as you are debugging one in production. Responsibilities Design and build agentic systems and automation from scratch, including automated evaluation loops that let the system measure its own success and iterate faster. Own large-scale data pipelines: high record volumes, control groups, statistical validation, and full traceability of how data flows through the system. Apply workflow orchestration to keep complex, high-throughput processing reliable under real load. Take on hands-on work when the day calls for it — SQL, custom reports, and direct fixes. Act as a technical counterpart for architecture and design reviews. Requirements Strong architectural thinking — you reason in components, ownership boundaries, and reusability before reaching for code or config. Experience building agentic systems and automation independently, not only assembling existing frameworks. Hands-on work with data at real scale — pipelines processing millions of records rather than thousands. Backgrounds in ad tech, high-load financial systems, cybersecurity / anomaly detection, or data engineering translate well. A strong instinct for reliability — systems that handle load and edge cases without silent failures, and a habit of validating results with control groups before trusting them. A research-minded approach — able to run a clean experiment and stand behind a result under scrutiny, not just ship something that mostly works. Comfort moving across backend, SQL, reporting, and operations. Nice to have Research experience (academic or applied) where you had to defend results, not just deploy them. Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tooling. A history of mentoring engineers technically through design and architecture discussions. What we offer — Flexible Work Environment: Opportunity to work remotely. — 1:1 English Classes: Individual English language training to enhance your communication skills. — Premium Medical Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance to ensure your well-being. — Great Team: Work with a supportive, collaborative, and dynamic international team. — Equipment Provided: All necessary equipment supplied for efficient job performance. — Accounting Support: Full accounting assistance in Ukraine and Poland. — Paid Time Off: 18 days of Annual Vacation and 7 days of Sick Leave without a doctor's note. — Flexible payment system , which allows you to withdraw funds in one click and has about twenty withdrawal options.

review_candidates.description: Job Purpose Role is responsible for coordinating automation related activities, including breakdown and preventive maintenance, implementation of corrective actions and system modifications and conception, raising CP and implementation of capital projects and ensuring safe operations for Zone 3. Ensuring compliance to ISO 9001 & 14001 and OHSAS 18001 procedures for all activities related to this function. To ensure that the machines operate with good reliability, routine checking of network, PLC & HMI services, Drives and take corrections/corrective actions on abnormalities observed during the routine checks. As the existing systems are relatively old this position is accountable to find out weaknesses and potential risks in the system and plan to remove them. Responsible for the procurement & installing the sensors for digitization of the plant. These sensors will be used for data analysis. To implement, enhance and maintain the system, database & functionalities of the digitalization systems of the plant. All the Capex related projects & development work for data bases, data analytics & monitoring are to be implemented by this position. The focus is to implement digital initiatives and look for the opportunities for the improvement through digitalization. This job position is the Digital Ambassador for the plant. Job Context & Major Challenges Job Context Analyzing the breakdowns with tools like why-why analysis to arrive at corrective and preventive actions and one-point lessons and ensure compliance to decided actions as per plan. Make & implement small modifications in the systems & logic to improve the performance from operation, maintenance, energy or safety point of view, arrange for the requisite materials and implement them. Planning of Capex- raise CP, seek approval, finalize technical specifications, assist in commercial negotiations, arrange for the procurement of materials as required, implement the projects as per the technical and operational requirements and validate the projects against the original plan. Get feedback from operators and maintenance team on unsafe conditions existing, investigate accidents, near miss incidents and environment incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions. Impart training on digital platforms and work on digital platforms to make them user-friendly. Fully support major projects in the zone to help in trouble free commissioning and operations. Modify the logic for operations, if necessary, to improve operation and quality performances. Look for the opportunities of improvement through Digital initiatives and implement them. Job Challenges Acquiring knowledge on the operation and function of components of some machines. Ensuring availability of spares for equipment’s at the same time maintaining the expenses within budget. Recycle & repair spares wherever proper spares are not available in the market for the machines, which are old, and spares are obsolete. Upgrade equipment’s with proper planning and technical inputs to ensure improved performance and better reliability are achieved. Acquiring expertise on the various components of Digitization. Maintaining the up-time of digital platforms to avoid data loss.
